svg.title: Taxonomy of all 12 Fullmag physical interactions: conservative effective fields vs direct spin torques
svg.desc: Taxonomy of Fullmag's 12 physical interactions grouped by variational role and LLG entry channel: (a) local energy densities (Zeeman, Anisotropy, Magnetoelastic), (b) differential operators and natural boundary conditions (Exchange, DMI, Inter-region couplings), (c) nonlocal operators (Demagnetization, Oersted field), (d) stochastic thermal Brown noise H_th, and (e) non-conservative direct spin torques (Slonczewski/Zhang-Li STT, Prescribed SOT, Drift-diffusion spin torque) entering the explicit LLG right-hand side.

Preserves m · ∂tm = 0 on S2; planner enforces per-interaction lane legality.
